Let me think through this carefully.

Pete Sampras won 14 Grand Slam titles during his career. Let me consider which ones he won in the 20th century (before 2001):

- Wimbledon: He won 7 times (1993, 1994, 1995, 1997, 1998, 1999, 2000)
- US Open: He won 5 times (1990, 1993, 1995, 1996, 2002 - but 2002 is 21st century)
- Australian Open: He won 2 times (1994, 1997)
- French Open: He never won this tournament

The question asks which Grand Slam he did NOT win in the 20th century. Since Sampras never won the French Open at all (in any century), this is clearly the correct answer.
